verdict.rationale: Bland's docs directly cover every piece of the story: building a prompt via pathways (bland-docs-18/26/30/38), picking or cloning a voice (bland-docs-33, bland-docs-10), acquiring/porting a phone number via Twilio or SIP (bland-docs-3, bland-docs-17), and a dedicated 'build your first agent' walkthrough with in-browser talk testing (bland-docs-39) plus dev/staging/prod environments (bland-docs-42) for going live quickly. This is squarely the product's core use case, not a stretch. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on account or explicit timing benchmark confirming a first live call actually happens within an hour, and the only community evidence (bland-comm-1) is about cost, not setup speed.
